en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, and a number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Abu Nasr, altogether from jameel Bin Darraj, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
Al-Quroo, it is what is between the two menstruations’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr and A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from ibn abu Nasr all from Jamil ibn Darraj from Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Al-Qur’ is the period between two Hayd (menses).”’
